input.subject: Rat activity in the kitchen – proofing works update
input.body:
Address: 14 Mosswold Crescent, Brindlewick, ZZ1 1ZZ

Hi Gareth,

I am following up on the rat activity in the kitchen at the above property. Elise has told us that pest control attended on Sunday 7 September and removed their equipment. She understood that a separate contractor would attend on Monday 8 September to deal with the openings, but nobody came. As far as we know, the openings by the kitchen sink and drain are still not sealed, and we have no completion confirmation or pest control report on file.

Can you please let us know who is carrying out the proofing work, what they will be doing and when they will attend? Please also send us the pest controller's report if you have it. If you would prefer us to send one of our contractors to inspect and quote for sealing the openings, please let us know and we will arrange this.

As there have been rats inside the kitchen, we would be grateful for a reply as soon as possible.

Kind regards
Northbridge Lettings

input.decision: Stage: the landlord is handling the job with his own contractor (events 006–008), but the job has stalled. Rules: PM-AUTH-004, PM-WORKFLOW-002, PM-SAFE-001. Evidence: events 010, 014, 017 and 018. Pest treatment finished on 07/09. The proofing contractor expected on 08/09 did not attend and has not been rebooked, so the openings by the sink and drain are still unsealed. The landlord has not written since 18/08. Rats inside the kitchen are a health hazard, so this is P1, not routine. I did not send our own contractor because the landlord chose his own route, and sending a second contractor or dispatching without his approval is not allowed. I emailed the landlord asking who is doing the proofing, what they will do, when they will attend, and for the pest report. I also offered our contractor to inspect and quote if he prefers. I sent him an SMS pointer, updated the tenant by email with an SMS pointer, and held the case for the landlord until 12/09. I escalated P1 so a person can phone the landlord, because he asked for calls, and the tenant, who prefers phone. Next steps in order: the landlord replies or is phoned on 12/09. If he names a contractor and a date, tell the tenant and hold until the visit, then close without payment once he confirms it is done. If he wants our contractor, assign one under his recorded approval.
